title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find product ad templates for a photo or a short video. Pick a style, add one product photo, and get a new file for your store or a social post.
h1: Product Ad Templates: Pick a Look, Rebuild It, Post It
lead: Product ad templates turn a photo you already have into a speaking clip. Add your leather duffel and skip the blank prompt.
card: Ready-made layouts for product pictures and short clips. Add your photo and download the next file.

faq.q: What is a product ad template?
faq.a: A product ad template is a finished layout for your product, with the scene and the speaking pace already set. Add the leather duffel photo, and an AI actor can deliver the line. You are not building the ad from an empty timeline.

faq.q: How does a product ad template work?
faq.a: You add the product photo or the product link, then set the one line a buyer would actually say. When the frame shows your serum, an AI actor speaks it. Save the clip, or post it from this project.

faq.q: Why use a template instead of hiring a creator?
faq.a: The creator you wanted is booked, and a second opening line can still be made while you wait. A serum ad can get that new line, plus a fresh script, without a new booking.

faq.q: Who are these product ad templates for?
faq.a: A founder with one necklace photo, a marketer refreshing this month's ads, and an agency making a client file all start here. The shared step is a picture of the item you already sell.

faq.q: I have never edited a video. Can I still use a template?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a watch photo and the three steps above. If a caption runs long, shorten it in the editor, or drop a song under the voice.

faq.q: Which kinds of shops have templates here?
faq.a: Use the category buttons on the wall. You will find accessories, apparel, apps, beauty and personal care, and clothing. E-commerce, education, explainers, financial services, food and beverage, and footwear are there too. So are health and fitness, jewelry, kids and toys, pets, sports, tech, UGC creator-style ads, and viral layouts.

faq.q: Am I allowed to bring my own pictures and clips?
faq.a: Yes, if you have the right to use them. A front-on photo of the frying pan and your shop wordmark are a usual pair. A clip you filmed yourself can come in too, with up to 7 reference images on one job.

faq.q: Where can I publish a file from these layouts?
faq.a: Pick the length first: 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds, at 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits. A tall 9:16 file is what a TikTok placement usually wants. Use a square 1:1 for a feed post, 16:9 when the placement is wide, and 4:3 or 3:4 when the slot asks for those. YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn can take the download, or you can publish from a connected account.

Yes. A photo spends 24 credits, and a clip spends 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost before you start, and a failed job returns the credits. Prices are on the [pricing page](page:pricing). Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600.

faq.q: Can I use the download in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. A necklace clip can run as a paid ad, and the same file can go to a client. The download has no watermark, and you still need rights to the product photo. An AI twin can keep one face across versions. The API can start the next file from your catalog.

faq.q: Why not start from an empty timeline?
faq.a: The layout already sets the scene, the hook, and the pace, so you decide the offer and post. A tea tin ad does not start by building the kitchen from nothing.

steps_h2: How to Make a Product Ad From a Template in 3 Steps
steps_lead: You get a speaking ad from a layout you already like. The leather duffel below is the product, and the credit line shows first.
benefits_lead: Open one card and the ad is already a speaking clip. You bring the product photo.

benefits.d: For a backpack, the draft can open on the padded strap, not on a generic hello. Change the color name in that line and the ad matches your listing.
A generated voice reads the script out loud, in the language you pick for that version. Shoppers hear the line while they watch.
The words sit on the video, so shoppers can read the line while the voice plays. A candle ad can show the scent name on screen.

benefits.t: An AI Avatar From the Library
benefits.d: An AI avatar from the library can hold the necklace in a daylight close-up. If the face should be yours, an AI twin can be built from photos you already took.
You can trim the blender clip to the sentence about the glass jar, and lay a track under it in the editor.

benefits.t: From a Product Link to a Post
benefits.d: A headphone product page can drive the first draft, so you paste that link instead of describing the item from scratch. A second language can reuse the same photo, and your own software can start the job through the API.
